image_id: Exact official test.json class/stem string, no extension or images/ prefix
class_mapping: sorted(test.json.keys()) enumerated 0..100, exact torchvision Food101 semantics
hash_class_token: Decimal clean class_id without leading zero padding
hash_encoding: UTF-8, literal pipe separators, no trailing newline; lowercase SHA256 hex
wrong_label_mapping: int(full SHA256 hex,16) modulo 100, indexed into ascending labels excluding clean class; big-endian integer interpretation
request_manifest_order: ascending global row; R1 membership selected by per-class R1 hash, R2 union of remaining corrupted history and all corrupted E
per_image_label_version: Every corrupted requested image begins at version 0 and is corrected once to version 1; R1 and R2 are disjoint
dataset_semantic_digest: Canonical SHA256 of {class_to_idx, images}; each image excludes absolute path only
group_semantic_digest: Canonical SHA256 of the complete group images list, including exact paths/bytes/source hashes
